Play **b7**.

I wouldn’t memorize a fixed “next two moves” because White has several replies after **b7**. After you play it, tell me White’s move/board and I’ll give the exact next Black move. In general after **b7**: take a corner if White opens one, and avoid handing over **a8/h1** unless the count still works.
